title: Clarify ARIA semantics and focus visuals for dashboard widgets and data components
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Audit and remediate accessibility issues across dashboard widgets (cards, tables, charts, controls) focusing on ARIA semantics, keyboard navigation, and visible focus. Produce VPAT-aligned artifacts and design tokens guidance so engineering can ship consistent fixes across hosted and private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: All dashboard interactive components have defined roles and tab order documented in the component spec
Keyboard navigation works predictably with no hidden focus traps in table pagination, sortable headers, and chart tooltips
Visual focus meets 3:1 contrast for focus outlines and 4.5:1 for text where required; tokens updated and audited
VPAT checklists for updated components completed and attached to the ticket
A single PR per component family (tables, charts, controls) with design sign-off and automated accessibility test coverage
implementation_notes: Add aria-describedby to table summaries and aria-sort to sortable headers
Introduce 'landmark' tokens for dashboard sections: region roles and unique labels to improve screen reader navigation
Use aria-live="polite" for non-critical chart updates and aria-hidden for purely decorative SVG elements
Standardize focus outline via a new semantic token --focus-ring which maps to accessible contrast-friendly color tokens; fallback for high-contrast mode
Coordinate with Eng on runtime tooltip focus transfer policy to avoid loss of keyboard focus when opening chart tooltips
steps: Run Axe/Deque CI audit across staging dashboard (record baseline issues)
Produce Figma patches showing updated focus states and ARIA annotations (link below)
Draft VPAT entries for affected components and share with compliance
Create GitHub branches: design/dash-a11y-tokens, design/tables-aria, design/charts-live-region
Pilot changes on a single customer-facing dashboard in staging and collect assistive-tech smoke test notes
